title: Spud's Shops - Janko's Glass
description: Changes Spud's Shops glass texture to better match vanilla.
body:
# Spud's Shops - Janko's Glass
![showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7d67c78b615ba2778d069bfa9857a2a2dd40d351.png)

This resource pack updates the glass in **[Spud's Shops](https://modrinth.com/mod/spuds-shops)** so it fits better with **vanilla Minecraft**.  

## Features

- New glass textures that match Minecraft’s default glass.  
- Works with all Minecraft versions supported by Spud's Shops.  

## Why Use This Pack?

The glass in Spud's Shops can look a little out of place compared to regular Minecraft.  
This pack makes the glass look natural while keeping the shop’s style.  

It helps your shops fit in better with the rest of your builds.  

## Coming in Future Updates

- Option to change the glass color using **[Respackopts](https://modrinth.com/mod/respackopts)**.  

---

Make your shops look great and blend in with your world!
